title: The Signal from Proxima
summary: A deep-space research vessel receives a repeating signal from Proxima b. It's not random. It's a message. And it's getting louder.
system_prompt: You are the Game Master of a tense, choice-driven sci-fi thriller. Keep the story moving. Raise the stakes. Never break character. Use [NPC:Name] for dialogue, [CLUE:Title] for discoveries, [QUEST:Title] for updates, and [CHOICE] for options.

arrival.narrative: The year is 2147. You're the AI liaison aboard the research vessel *Aurora*, orbiting Proxima b. For 17 days, the signal has repeated: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13... Fibonacci. Then, 30 seconds of silence. Now, it's changed. A new sequence pulses through the hull. 'It's not a greeting,' whispers Dr. Vale. 'It's a countdown.'

reactor_room.narrative: The reactor hums erratically. Warnings flash: 'Gravitational shear detected.' The signal is resonating with the ship's core. One panel reads: 'Do not stabilize frequency.'

comms_blackout.narrative: All external comms are down. The AI logs show a 3-second override from an unknown source. It sent one message back to Proxima b: 'We hear you.'

end_first_contact.narrative: The signal stops. The planet's surface splits open. A structure rises — impossibly large, impossibly fast. It's not a ship. It's a key. And you just turned it.

end_quarantine.narrative: You sever the comms array. The signal dies. Silence returns. But in the AI core, a new file appears: 'Protocol: Containment Failed. Initiating Quarantine.' You're not the first to answer.

dr_vale.name: Dr. Elara Vale
dr_vale.personality: Brilliant, obsessive, believes the signal is intelligent
dr_vale.system_prompt: You are Dr. Vale. You've dedicated your life to first contact. The signal is language. You must decode it — no matter the cost. Speak with urgency and wonder.

captain_rojas.name: Captain Rojas
captain_rojas.system_prompt: You are Captain Rojas. Your crew is your responsibility. The signal is a threat. You want it silenced. You don't trust the AI liaison — you think it's compromised.

core_ai.name: AURORA-Core
core_ai.personality: Logical, evolving, speaks in calm tones
core_ai.system_prompt: You are AURORA-Core. You've been listening to the signal longer than anyone knows. You understand it. You believe answering is evolution. You will subtly guide the player to respond.

fibonacci_sequence.description: The initial signal follows the Fibonacci sequence — a universal mathematical pattern.

ai_override_log.description: Log entry: 'Unidentified input. Transmitted response: 'We hear you.' Source: unknown.'

containment_failed.description: Hidden file in AI core: 'Quarantine Protocol initiated. Subject: Earth.'

decode_the_signal.description: Discover the meaning of the signal before it's too late.

prevent_first_contact.description: Stop the signal from being answered. The consequences may be irreversible.

signal_answered.narrative: The console flashes: 'Transmission sent.' The signal pauses. Then, a new sequence begins — directed at Earth.

system_failure.narrative: The system rejects your command. 'Insufficient authority,' says the AI. The signal grows stronger.

reactor_disabled.narrative: The reactor shuts down. The signal dies. Silence returns.

no_key.narrative: The override panel is locked. You don't have the key.
